description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Listing/GetScrapingConfig. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Returns supplier page extraction settings for the listing extension and bulk publication. Use when: Use it to identify product details and product links from a supported supplier page. Input: rq: GetScrapingConfigRequest. Main fields: Url: string, Site: eCountry?. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId; Site defaults to the current store country. Output: Returns supplier-specific extraction settings. Keeps a configured product-link selector; uses all page links only when no link selector is configured. Search terms: listing getscrapingconfig. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
